audio.Scope: Real isolated AAC-LC/24-bit Ogg FLAC, synthetic live mix and recovery only. No HE-AAC/18-output/normalization/limiter/actual-PC/24-72h or mouse acceptance.

Cases.Source: New independent implementation; no production configuration or services accessed.

Checks.Description: The program continues across a full song/ad/sweeper cycle.
Both encoders and source sessions remain persistent across content boundaries.
Healthy outputs lose no PCM blocks.
Audit work does not overflow or fail.
No decoder error on /next-baseline-aac
Decoded listener audio exceeds 8 seconds on /next-baseline-aac
No low-RMS 20 ms windows after initial decoder priming on /next-baseline-aac
Listener hears multiple actual content transitions on /next-baseline-aac
Decoded tone order has no skips or repeats on /next-baseline-aac
No decoder error on /next-baseline-flac
Decoded listener audio exceeds 8 seconds on /next-baseline-flac
No low-RMS 20 ms windows after initial decoder priming on /next-baseline-flac
Listener hears multiple actual content transitions on /next-baseline-flac
Decoded tone order has no skips or repeats on /next-baseline-flac
Playback journal hash chain is valid.
Event acknowledgements do not duplicate journal rows.
Music, advertisements and sweepers produce separate occurrence records.
Orderly stop leaves a terminal record for every started occurrence.
Completed assets retain their exact sample counts, including boundaries inside a 20 ms block.
Program sample positions never reset during output recovery: baseline
No track is repeated or advanced by transport recovery: baseline
Daily local report contains one record per station occurrence, independent of output variants.

Cases.Source: New independent implementation; no production configuration or services accessed.

Checks.Description: Real Ogg FLAC listener decoded at least two seconds of stereo PCM.
Decoded FLAC follows the original 24-bit sample sequence across repeated file boundaries.
Sub-16-bit sample detail survives the entire decoder/mix/encoder/listener path.
Distinct left and right channels remain distinct.
Independent stream probe confirms 48 kHz stereo 24-bit FLAC.
Real audio loop publishes continuous measured final-mix coverage without blocking outputs.
Measured final-mix window closes durably with real sample boundaries.
